messages:
incident-bot: @here Incident: Elevated 5xxs and rate-limit errors observed against Hosted API (eu-west-1) starting ~07:07 UTC. We're tracking as P2 (customer-impacting). Initial alert -> status.redwood.ai/incident/1795002468 :rotating_light:

ops-oncall: Seeing sustained spike in request volume to /v1/generate from a handful of IP blocks. 5xx rate up ~8% and token throttles spiking for free-tier routes. Investigating source and applying mitigation.

maria: Confirmed. Logs show many long-poll streaming sessions from one client hitting concurrent-session cap. KV cache pressure also increased (latency to redis up).

ashley: Rolling temporary rate-limits at the edge for anonymous/free-tier routes to cap concurrent sessions per IP to 10. Pushing policy now (edge config id: cfg-eu-rl-2026-03).

leo: Support: Getting first customer reports — 3 paying customers on EU hosted experiencing degraded responses and truncated streams. CS alerted and prepped status update draft.

karen: Product: We should prioritize returning 200 with partial content instead of 5xx where possible, to avoid SLO bleed. Are there safe fallbacks we can enable?

maria: Short-term: enable stream-fallback that returns incremental chunks + non-blocking handshake for sessions that exceed cache windows. Patch applied to runtime (rev r2.14.7) — see rollout logs below.

deploy-bot: deployment started by maria:runtime/r2.14.7 -> canary (eu-west-1) at 07:22 UTC

ops-oncall: Canary looks healthy, 5xxs dropping to baseline within canary pool. Proceeding with staged rollout over next 20m. Keeping soft rate-limits in place until full rollout completes.

maria: Observed one noisy client: 54.152.12.98 (ASN: AMAZON-EC2). IP shows repeated reconnect floods. Added temporary IP block and upstream WAF rule. Will follow up with partner outreach if it's a known integration.

ashley: Cache eviction thresholds tweaked to reduce thrashing: kv_cache.max_entries=250k -> 300k for eu pool. This reduces redis ops under the current load.

leo: Support update posted to customers: "We're seeing elevated errors in eu-west-1 impacting streaming; mitigations in progress. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary." Link: intranet.redwood.ai/cs/1795002468-draft

karen: Good. Let's make sure PROD status page has the right blurb and ETA. I drafted a short note, ready for publish after ops confirms stabilization.

ops-oncall: Stabilization metrics look good. 5xx rate back to baseline (0.6%) and token throttles decreased. Leaving soft rate-limits for 30m as buffer.

maria: Postmortem tasks: 1) add anomaly detector for long-poll concurrent session spikes, 2) improve per-client connection caps at edge, 3) investigate KV cache sizing heuristics for eu. Creating tickets.

deploy-bot: full rollout complete at 07:48 UTC (runtime r2.14.7) -> all eu-west-1 inference pools.

ops-oncall: Current status: mitigated, customer impact reduced to "limited intermittent degradation". Will move to monitoring phase. Follow-up incident summary + RCA will be posted in ~48h.

maria: Quick logs snippet for triage: 
```
[07:09:12] ERROR token_service: kv_cache_miss latency=124ms client=54.152.12.98 sessions=128
[07:09:13] WARN  stream_handler: reconnect flood client=54.152.12.98 conn_rate=180/s
```

leo: CS will reach out to the 3 affected customers with personalized notes.

karen: Thanks team. Please add any follow-ups to the incident board (project: infra-incidents) and tag me for comms review.

incident-bot: Status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Public status page: status.redwood.ai/incidents/1795002468 (internal draft visible at intranet.redwood.ai/incidents/1795002468)

maria: Filing RCA draft now. Will assign owners for cache and rate-limit improvements.

ops-oncall: Closing thread for real-time ops. If any regressions, reopen or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
